_comment: Completed goals the owner deleted while the app was being rebuilt (09/2026), restored from his own description. Consumed by scripts/restore-goals.js. Distances in km, climbing in m. keyRides = the event ride(s) that completed the goal; the script finds them in synced_activities and uses the latest match as completed_at. If the dry run picks the wrong ride, pin it with "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" on that keyRide.
